verdict.rationale: Ramp docs mention multi-entity support with entity-level restrictions and dynamic approval routing across finance, IT, legal, and security, which implies some role/permission granularity across entities and departments, but there is no explicit documentation of a granular role/permission system covering locations and individual team members. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of role-based access control, granular permission settings per user/location/department, and independent corroboration of these controls.
